title: TabReliBench: Evaluating Tabular Foundation Models Beyond Predictive Accuracy
abstract: arXiv:2610.13654v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are increasingly popular for their strong predictive performance. Many also provide posterior predictive distributions (PPDs), whose reliability remains less studied. We assess reliability through point prediction, distributional quality, marginal and subgroup calibration, and interval efficiency. We then introduce TabReliBench, a large classification and regression benchmark for these comparisons and dataset-level analyses. We find that TFMs' rankings change between TabArena and our benchmark and across reliability metrics. Regression TFMs usually achieve near-nominal marginal coverage and retain narrow intervals, but this favorable marginal behavior does not imply valid conditional coverage. Dataset-level analyses show that classification difficulty often accompanies poor calibration, whereas regression predictive performance is not a reliable indicator of calibration. translated_title: TabReliBench：超越预测精度的表格基础模型可靠性评估
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型（TFM）因其强大的预测性能而日益流行。其中许多模型还提供后验预测分布（PPD），但其可靠性仍然较少被研究。我们通过点预测、分布质量、边际与子群校准以及区间效率来评估可靠性。随后，我们提出了 TabReliBench，一个用于上述比较以及数据集层面分析的大型分类与回归基准。我们发现，TFM 的排名在 TabArena 与我们的基准之间、以及在不同可靠性指标之间会发生变化。回归类 TFM 通常能够达到接近名义水平的边际覆盖率并保持较窄的区间，但这种良好的边际表现并不意味着有效的条件覆盖。数据集层面的分析显示，分类难度往往伴随着较差的校准，而回归任务的预测性能并不能可靠地指示其校准情况。集成方法可以提升预测性……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 提出了 TabReliBench，一个从校准、分布质量与区间效率等可靠性维度超越单纯预测精度来系统评估表格基础模型的大型分类与回归基准，发现模型排名随可靠性指标而变化，且良好的边际覆盖并不代表有效的条件覆盖。
en_tdlr: TabReliBench is a large classification and regression benchmark that evaluates tabular foundation models beyond predictive accuracy — covering point prediction, distributional quality, calibration, and interval efficiency — revealing that model rankings shift across reliability metrics and that near-nominal marginal coverage does not imply valid conditional coverage.
